## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
UPDATE update_ops_orders
SET o_comment = 'selective_10pct'
WHERE o_orderkey <= (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(o_orderkey) * 0.1 AS INTEGER)
  FROM update_ops_orders
)
```
